map.等额本金每月还的本金固定，利息随余额递减，总利息更少但首月压力大；等额本息每月固: Equal principal repays a fixed slice of principal each month with interest shrinking alongside the balance, so total interest is lower but the first payment bites hardest; equal installment keeps payments level, is interest-heavy early and costs slightly more overall. Choose installment when cash is tight, principal when it is comfortable.
map.🧾 别被「月费率」误导: 🧾 Do Not Be Misled by the Monthly Fee Rate
map.信用卡分期常用月费率，因本金在递减，月费率×12 不等于真实年化。用月供反推 I: Card installments quote a monthly fee rate; because principal keeps shrinking, rate × 12 is not the true annualized cost. Back out the IRR from the monthly payment to get the real price of money.

map.车价 15 万、首付 30%（4.5 万）、贷款 10.5 万、年化 4.8%、: Vehicle price 150,000 yuan, down payment 30% (45,000 yuan), loan 105,000 yuan, 4.8% annual rate, 3 years (36 payments): monthly rate r = 0.048/12 = 0.004, payment = 105000×0.004×(1.004)^36/((1.004)^36−1) ≈ 3137.5 yuan (about 3138 yuan), with total interest = 3137.5×36 − 105000 ≈ 7951 yuan.
map.等额本息和等额本金哪个划算？: Which works out better, equal installment or equal principal?
map.等额本金前期还的本金多、总利息更少，但月供前高后低；等额本息每月固定、前期利息占: Equal principal repays more principal early and carries less total interest, but payments start high and taper; equal installment holds one level payment each month with a heavy interest share up front. If money is comfortable now, principal saves more; if you want stability, pick installment.
map.年化利率和月费率怎么换算？: How do annual rate and monthly fee rate convert?
map.月费率×12 不等于年化，因本金在递减。信用卡分期等用月费率时真实年化更高，需用: Monthly fee rate × 12 is not the annual rate, because principal keeps shrinking; products quoting a monthly rate carry a higher true annual cost. Derive the real rate from the payment using IRR and do not be fooled by a low monthly figure.
